messages:
maria: getting lots of pager noise from sparkpay tenant, ~40 pages in last 90s. looks like the tenant-specific latency check is firing repeatedly.
SRE-Bot: ALERT: check 'sparkpay/embed-latency' triggered (SLA breach). Incident INC-2178314520 created. Paging policy: tenant-critical -> pages oncall.
Ajay: ack — taking triage. i'll look at router and model routing first.
maria: noted high p50 on us-west-2 GPU pool, only affecting sparkpay. other tenants appear normal in the same window.
Mike: thx ajay. any evidence of infra saturation? cpu/gpu util not pegged. could be cache churn.
Ajay: tailing logs now, seeing repeated KV cache miss spikes tied to tenant request ids. looks correlated with canary from last night (model rollouts).
Jessica: propose immediate tenant-level quieting to stop the churn of pages while y'all dig in. prefer tenant silence vs global mute.
Ajay: agreed. applying silence for 15m. command: `/incident silence --tenant sparkpay --duration 15m --reason "live investigation - reducing pager noise"`
SRE-Bot: ACTION: Silence applied by Ajay for tenant 'sparkpay' (15m). Suppression ID PS-2178314538. Pages will be suppressed but logged.
Ajay: doing controlled fallback to an older, quantized variant that was stable. command: `/route set --tenant sparkpay --model rdx-small-quant --strategy gradual --pct 30`
Mike: routing change observed. traffic shift ~30% to rdx-small-quant in ~2m. p50 dropped from ~650ms -> ~320ms for sparkpay.
maria: nice. verify no downstream errors with the variant. quick smoke passed for embed quality.
Jessica: opening alert tweak ticket: link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RGW-987 — will add action to create tenant-scoped alerts, raise threshold to 750ms for p50 temporarily and add dashboard tile with tenant filter.
Ajay: capturing request-ids into a temporary logging tag to trace cache misses: `log.add_tag(tenant=sparkpay, incident=INC-2178314520)` and collecting samples.
Mike: i've extended the suppression by +30m from my side in case the fix takes longer. command: `/incident silence extend PS-2178314538 --add 30m`
SRE-Bot: ACTION: Suppression PS-2178314538 extended by Mike for additional 30m. New expiry in 45m.
Ajay: preliminary root cause hypothesis: canary rolled a model variant with different KV-key shapes causing cache warmups and high miss rate for high-QPS tenant. regression only visible under tenant load profile.
maria: action items — create canary rollback checklist, require tenant-simulated load during model canaries, add automatic fallback rule when per-tenant p50 > threshold AND cache-miss-rate increased.
Jessica: i'll update the alerting runbook and create the dashboard tile now. dashboard panel: `embed_latency.p50{tenant:sparkpay}` with 1m and 5m series + a cache-miss-rate panel.
Ajay: filing post-incident tasks in RGW-987: investigate canary config, add unit test for KV key schema, add alert suppression play to runbook, document per-tenant routing fallback steps.
ops-tilly: handoff note: Ajay will be primary until 10:40 UTC, then Mike will take over. @Mike please monitor for another 30m and confirm suppression cleanup once done.
Mike: got it. i'll watch error budget, ensure suppression ID removed when safe, and coordinate postmortem meeting. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-2178314520 status: MITIGATED — pages suppressed and latency regressed back under temporary thresholds. closed at 2178315670.
maria: thanks team. owners: Ajay (tech lead), Jessica (alerting + dashboard), Mike (handoff + verification). we'll sync 09:30 tomorrow to review RGW-987 and ship the runbook updates. :white_check_mark:
